name: When is the best time to schedule finish carpentry work during a home renovation project?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to schedule finish carpentry work during a home renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry is typically performed towards the end of a renovation project, after most of the major construction, electrical, plumbing, and drywall work is complete. This timing ensures that the delicate finished wood products are not damaged during heavier construction phases. Walls should be painted or primed before trim and molding installation to avoid paint lines on new wood. Flooring is often installed before baseboards. Coordinating with your general contractor in the Bay Area is crucial to integrate finish carpentry seamlessly into the project timeline, ensuring a smooth progression to project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule finish carpentry near the end of a renovation, after major construction, electrical, plumbing, and drywall. It should ideally follow painting and precede some flooring installations.
